games.name: Clash of Clans
games.award_evidence: Google Play's 2024 winner page names Clash of Clans as Best multi-device game in the US.

mechanics.name: Clan Games tiers
mechanics.detail: Individual challenges add to shared clan points; tiers unlock for the whole clan and maxing personal points adds a reward choice.

mechanics.name: Daily Star Bonus
mechanics.detail: Five stars complete a bonus, then a 24-hour timer starts; up to two bonuses can stack and higher leagues pay more.

games.return_reason: A short daily target feeds a social, longer-horizon clan ladder, with visible progress and a reason to return before the timer expires.
games.allworld_transfer: Pair one daily activity threshold with a neighbourhood meter and a visible shared reward tier.
games.risk: Timers and clan pressure can make low-value actions feel compulsory.

games.name: Clash Royale
games.award_evidence: Google Play Japan lists Clash Royale among the awarded works in its 2016 Best Competitive Game category; this was a category honoree, not the later grand prize.

mechanics.name: Arena and card collection
mechanics.detail: Winning battles advances arenas that unlock more cards; cards are collected and upgraded into stronger decks.

mechanics.name: Seasonal events and clans
mechanics.detail: Season passes add tower skins, emotes and magic items; clans share cards and enter wars for rewards.

games.return_reason: Each match can improve both competitive standing and collection depth, so the next session has immediate and long-term value.
games.allworld_transfer: Let a small activity improve a personal collection while also contributing to a civic or venue season.
games.risk: Power-linked collection upgrades can become perceived pay-to-win and overshadow social play.

games.name: Brawl Stars
games.award_evidence: Google Play's 2019 US winner page names Call of Duty: Mobile, not Brawl Stars, as Users' Choice Game.

mechanics.name: Short match modes
mechanics.detail: The official game page presents multiple modes and short team battles, making progress possible in compact sessions.

mechanics.name: Brawler progression
mechanics.detail: Players unlock and upgrade a roster of brawlers, then use distinct abilities across modes.

games.return_reason: Fast sessions reduce commitment cost while roster growth creates a persistent reason to try another mode or character.
games.allworld_transfer: Offer two-minute venue activities with distinct roles and a persistent badge or skill collection.
games.risk: Roster breadth can create balance and onboarding complexity.

games.name: Pokémon GO
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's Mobile Game archive marks Pokémon GO as the 2017 winner.

mechanics.name: Location discovery and collection
mechanics.detail: Niantic describes exploring the real world to find Pokémon, with PokéStops, Gyms and a growing Pokédex.

mechanics.name: Daily streak bonuses
mechanics.detail: The official support documentation describes daily catch and PokéStop streaks that build across consecutive days for increasing rewards.

games.return_reason: Place-based novelty and collection combine with a consecutive-day bonus that makes the next outing legible.
games.allworld_transfer: Tie discovery of real or simulated places to a collection book and forgiving daily activity streak.
games.risk: Location mechanics can exclude players without safe, accessible routes or nearby content.

games.name: Monument Valley
games.award_evidence: Apple's App Store listing explicitly identifies Monument Valley as a 2014 Apple Design Award winner.

mechanics.name: Hand-authored puzzle chapters
mechanics.detail: The official listing describes guiding Ida through discrete monuments, uncovering hidden paths and manipulating impossible geometry.

mechanics.name: Optional chapter expansion
mechanics.detail: The listing offers additional chapters as a separate purchase, extending the authored journey without changing the core puzzle language.

games.return_reason: A new chapter is a self-contained invitation to return, with discovery and completion carrying the motivation instead of a daily timer.
games.allworld_transfer: Build short, authored resident or landmark episodes with a clear reveal and optional adjacent stories.
games.risk: Purely authored content is expensive to produce and can run out without a durable social loop.

games.name: Monument Valley 2
games.award_evidence: The Game Awards' 2017 edition archive names Monument Valley 2 as Best Mobile Game.

mechanics.name: Two-character puzzle relationship
mechanics.detail: ustwo describes guiding a mother and child through changing architecture, with new interactions built around their dynamics.

mechanics.name: Transforming levels
mechanics.detail: Levels change through light, pathways and geometry, creating fresh state changes rather than repeated grind.

games.return_reason: Narrative relationship and novel puzzle states give each return a specific emotional or mechanical question to resolve.
games.allworld_transfer: Use paired character arcs where a player’s action changes the relationship and opens the next place or scene.
games.risk: Novelty-heavy puzzles can frustrate players if the interaction grammar is not taught clearly.

games.name: Alto's Adventure
games.award_evidence: The developer lists App Store Best of 2015 recognition, but the cited page does not establish an award-category win.

mechanics.name: Endless run with goals
mechanics.detail: The official site presents a continuous snowboarding journey with changing landmarks and a run-based loop.

mechanics.name: Character and equipment unlocks
mechanics.detail: The game’s progression is built around improving runs and unlocking additional playable characters and abilities.

games.return_reason: Runs are immediately replayable, while goals and unlocks turn repeated failure into gradual capability.
games.allworld_transfer: Create repeatable micro-routes with a score target, a forgiving retry, and unlockable movement or style options.
games.risk: Score chasing can become repetitive without new route variation or social meaning.

games.name: Alto's Odyssey
games.award_evidence: Snowman's official press page records Alto's Odyssey as a 2018 Apple Design Award winner.

mechanics.name: Biome-based runs
mechanics.detail: The official game page describes an endless sandboarding journey through evolving landscapes with new movement opportunities.

mechanics.name: Zen Mode
mechanics.detail: The developer documents a score-free mode focused on movement and scenery, giving the same system a lower-pressure return path.

games.return_reason: The same route system supports mastery, exploration and calm play, allowing different return motives without separate products.
games.allworld_transfer: Give Allworld activities both a challenge track and a relaxed exploration track with shared cosmetics.
games.risk: Multiple modes can split attention and make the core reward economy harder to explain.

games.name: Florence
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's Mobile Game archive marks Florence as the 2019 winner.

mechanics.name: Interactive vignette chapters
mechanics.detail: The official listing describes a wordless story told through short interactive scenes and everyday interactions.

mechanics.name: Relationship progression
mechanics.detail: The scenes change as Florence’s relationship develops, using interaction difficulty and rhythm to express emotional state.

games.return_reason: Players return to complete the next emotional beat, with changing interaction language making the narrative itself the progression ladder.
games.allworld_transfer: Use short resident vignettes where task form changes with trust, conflict or intimacy rather than only increasing numbers.
games.risk: A highly authored emotional arc may not support indefinite daily replay.

games.name: Threes!
games.award_evidence: The developer press kit lists the 2014 Apple Design Award as a win for Threes!.

mechanics.name: Finite board with emergent combinations
mechanics.detail: The developer describes a tiny puzzle whose rules create a deep challenge that can be played repeatedly.

mechanics.name: Score and best-run pursuit
mechanics.detail: Each run produces a score and tile history, making improvement and personal records the persistent reward.

games.return_reason: A complete run is short enough to retry immediately, and personal bests turn failure into information rather than a dead end.
games.allworld_transfer: Offer compact repeatable civic puzzles or table challenges with personal records and no mandatory timer.
games.risk: A self-score loop can lack social belonging or a narrative reason to return.

games.name: Honkai: Star Rail
games.award_evidence: Google Play's 2023 US winner page names Honkai: Star Rail as Best Game.

mechanics.name: Quest and character progression
mechanics.detail: The official listing describes story exploration, turn-based combat, character building and a growing roster.

mechanics.name: Live events and resource cycles
mechanics.detail: HoYoverse describes continual updates and events that add stories, characters and limited activities.

games.return_reason: Persistent roster investment makes each session useful, while new authored content supplies periodic reasons to come back.
games.allworld_transfer: Separate durable resident relationships from rotating city events, so returning players retain identity while finding novelty.
games.risk: Live-service calendars and random acquisition can create fatigue and spending pressure.

games.name: Genshin Impact

award.name: Apple App Store iPhone Game of the Year

games.award_evidence: Apple's Best of 2020 winner release names Genshin Impact as iPhone Game of the Year.

mechanics.name: Open-world exploration
mechanics.detail: HoYoverse describes a large world with regions, puzzles, quests, collectibles and elemental traversal.

mechanics.name: Original Resin cadence
mechanics.detail: HoYoWiki documents Original Resin as a resource that regenerates over time and is spent to claim rewards from repeatable activities.

games.return_reason: A persistent world rewards both planned daily maintenance and unstructured discovery, covering short and long sessions.
games.allworld_transfer: Combine daily resident errands with open-ended street discovery and a bounded resource that prevents endless grinding.
games.risk: Energy gates and random character acquisition can feel extractive or make content completion costly.

games.name: Marvel Snap

award.name: The Game Awards: Best Mobile Game

games.award_evidence: Second Dinner's official year-end post states that Marvel Snap won Best Mobile Game at The Game Awards 2022.

mechanics.name: Short matches
mechanics.detail: The official listing describes fast six-turn matches with simultaneous play and three locations to contest.

mechanics.name: Season missions and card collection
mechanics.detail: The listing describes collecting Marvel cards, upgrading variants and progressing through seasons and missions.

games.return_reason: Very short matches reduce the cost of re-entry; collection and season objectives give the next match a purpose.
games.allworld_transfer: Make social games completable in a few minutes, then layer optional weekly objectives over the same action.
games.risk: Collection gaps and rotating seasons can pressure players to chase content rather than inhabit the world.

games.name: Sky: Children of the Light

award.name: Apple App Store iPhone Game of the Year

games.award_evidence: thatgamecompany's official announcement records Sky as Apple's 2019 iPhone Game of the Year.

mechanics.name: Daily quests and seasonal spirits
mechanics.detail: The developer documents four daily quests for Candles and seasonal spirits with quests, expressions and cosmetics.

mechanics.name: Friendship progression
mechanics.detail: Players spend candles to unlock hand-holding, hugs, chat and other social abilities with friends.

games.return_reason: The daily task supplies a small reason to visit, while relationships and seasonal collectibles make return socially meaningful.
games.allworld_transfer: Reward helping and repeated encounters with residents or players through relationship abilities and shared cosmetics.
games.risk: Daily currency and seasonal returns can create fear of missing out for players with limited time.

games.name: The Room
games.award_evidence: BAFTA's 2013 results name The Room as the British Game winner; it was only a nominee in Mobile & Handheld.

mechanics.name: Layered physical puzzle boxes
mechanics.detail: Fireproof Games describes examining objects, finding hidden mechanisms and solving tactile multi-step puzzles.

mechanics.name: Chapter and mystery progression
mechanics.detail: Each box reveals more of the central mystery, giving the player a sequence of contained discoveries.

games.return_reason: Each chapter ends with a concrete unresolved mechanism or story question, making the next session self-directed.
games.allworld_transfer: Create optional street mysteries with inspectable objects, layered clues and a persistent case journal.
games.risk: Opaque clues can cause dead ends; hints need to preserve discovery without blocking progress.

games.name: Lara Croft GO
games.award_evidence: The Game Awards' 2015 edition archive names Lara Croft GO as Best Mobile/Handheld Game.

mechanics.name: Turn-based traversal puzzles
mechanics.detail: Square Enix describes moving Lara one turn at a time through ruins while manipulating enemies, traps and paths.

mechanics.name: Collectibles and chapter goals
mechanics.detail: The game includes relics, hidden items and chapter-based puzzles that reward thorough exploration.

games.return_reason: A deterministic turn system makes retrying a failed solution cheap, while hidden collectibles extend each chapter beyond the exit.
games.allworld_transfer: Use turn-like planning in short street puzzles and add optional discovery objects for completionists.
games.risk: Completion collectibles can feel like filler if they do not reveal story or world context.
